comment: Browser checks of scripts this track does not own that fail on the combined R2 tree, measured 2026-10-25. Each is tied to an open deviation (validation/build/content-r2.cjs) and is printed as KNOWN, not PASS. The list can only shrink: tests/e2e/run.cjs fails when a listed check passes (remove the entry) and on any failure that is not listed.

known.reason: reads the header title immediately after the click; with the hash router the title changes one tick later (a race in the script, not the application)
C11 to C14 drive the result correction form that the result workbench (M19) replaced; result-workbench.cjs covers the lock and the stale row
axe: button-name (critical), color-contrast (serious); same elements as tests/a11y/baseline.json
